handback.t:
Finding: ADDRESSED. `chatLive(state)` at hooks/chat.ts:76 is `sessionPreview && view === 'chat' && pane.isOpen`. It now gates every read, redraw and focus path:
- turn.start refresh: `onChatTurnStart` (chat.ts:110, called from register.ts:253). `startChatTurn` still runs ungated.
- Turn-end read: `endChatTurn` (chat.ts:145). The partial is still cleared ungated at chat.ts:146.
- Chunk redraws: `redrawChat` (chat.ts:86), plus a re-check inside the timer (chat.ts:93). `onChatChunk` still calls `appendPartial` ungated.
- After-send refresh: bindings.ts:412.
- `focusField('chat-send')`: controller.ts:431.

(a) The new tests do bite. Vitest at head: `tests/chat-gate.spec.ts` (5 tests) and `tests/chat-store.spec.ts` (12 tests) all pass, 17/17.
- At 138e32e64, the preview-off, closed and other-page cases would fail on `counts.messages` being 0.
- Before the fix, `onChatTurnStart` and `chatLive` did not exist; register.ts called `refreshChatAndDraw` ungated at turn.start, and `endChatTurn` always called `refreshChat`. That is one `messages()` call at turn start and one at turn end, so 2 instead of 0, in every case.
- At the old head, `chatLive` and `onChatTurnStart` don't exist, so the spec fails on import.
- The live test asserts `messages === 2` (turn start plus turn end), which pins the refresh-as-before behaviour. The preview-off and closed cases also assert `invalidates === 0` and that the partial clears.
- The focus test counts `host.focus` calls: 0 with preview off, more than 0 with preview on. It would have failed before, because focus was ungated for chat. I did not execute it against the old base.

(b) The two chat-store test edits (+4 lines in chat-store.spec.ts, setting `state.view = 'chat'` and `state.pane.isOpen = true`) are a consequence of the ruling, not a weakened assertion.
- Both tests depend on the turn-end read. Their assertions are unchanged: `msgs` equals the re-read rows, and the partial is '' (or 'second turn' for the stale-refresh race).
- The ungated partial-clearing behaviour is covered separately in chat-gate.spec.ts, for all three off modes.
- The 4,096-row cap lives in `keepChat` and is not touched by the diff. I did not find a cap assertion in the diff, and none was weakened.

(c) `openLoaders` is unchanged. It reads once at view-open.ts:31, gated on `sessionPreview` only, and is called only from `setView` (controller.ts:437), which is user-initiated. Restoring a pane closed on Chat does not go through `setView`, so it makes no read. Switching to Chat while the pane is closed would still do that single read (see out-of-scope).

(d) No ungated chat read or redraw is left. The only `host.session.messages` call site is `refreshChat` (chat.ts:61). Its callers are `refreshChatAndDraw` (view-open.ts:31, `onChatTurnStart`, bindings.ts:412) and `endChatTurn`. All are gated or an explicit open.
- register.ts:441 calls `redrawChat` after `endChatTurn`, and `redrawChat` is itself gated.
- The `host === null` fallbacks call only the store-only `startChatTurn` and `appendPartial`.

New breakage in the fix diff: none.

Out-of-scope observations:
- `setView('chat')` while the pane is closed and preview is on still does the single `openLoaders` read. Acceptable, since the user asked for it.
- `chatLive` lives in chat.ts, and controller.ts now imports from './chat'. The import direction is fine, but the chat module is now referenced from the controller.

Verdict: all findings addressed.
